  "phoneNote": "The arched images and serif typography suit a traditional barber, but the location appears too late and the hero has an unnecessary gap before the photos.",

    "Fix the header positioning so it stays at the viewport top without obscuring hero content in the full-page views.",
    "Reduce the desktop hero headline to two or three lines and place a compact location line beneath the business description on both screens.",
    "Tighten the phone hero gap, replace the tall opening-hours chart with compact rows, and reduce the desktop biography section's empty space."
